name: manifest_finalize
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
L=Path.cwd();exclude={'MANIFEST.json','manifest_finalize.receipt.json','manifest_finalize.output.txt'};files=[]
assert json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
for p in sorted(L.rglob('*')):
 if p.is_file():
  n=str(p.relative_to(L))
  if n in exclude:continue
  assert not p.is_symlink()
  b=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':n,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
manifest={'files':files,'terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions':{'MANIFEST.json':'Cannot include its own content hash','manifest_finalize.receipt.json':'Runner creates terminal receipt after this manifest completes','manifest_finalize.output.txt':'Runner creates terminal output after this manifest completes'},'frozen_after':'frozen-after.json all13matched','qualified_survivors':0,'credit':0}
s=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n';r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'MANIFEST.json'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
for row in files:assert hashlib.sha256((L/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(files),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'all_listed_hashes_verified':True,'frozen_bindings':13,'mismatches':0,'qualified_survivors':0,'credit':0,'terminal_exclusions':sorted(exclude)}))
